digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration, parity measurement harness
propositions: A paired, operator-run provider-parity harness must measure Bedrock against direct Anthropic across both class slots (standard/frontier) before the production review bot cutover in S8.
Bedrock inference-profile ids must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 and both model classes tested with and without temperature parameter support before corpus spend.
Payload parity and tool parity must be proven by captured outbound requests, not by code inspection, to confirm the same logical calls reach both providers with identical semantics.

Provider routing must be verified clean (zero non-Bedrock calls on the Bedrock arm) using per-call model logging from REBAR_USAGE_LOG to prevent split-brain confusion between direct Anthropic and Bedrock.

The parity corpus must pool gold-labeled cases across 15+ non-agentic specs, excluding completion-verifier/ticket-quality/spec-alignment ops that bypass resolve_gate_config, yielding 30 stratified items (15 block/15 advisory) at N=3 epochs.
Any capability difference that legitimately alters the provider request must be explicit and recorded (e.g., temperature withdrawal on opus via supports_temperature override), not silent.
